facts.fact: The Standards and Quality Act (Act 10 of 2003), assented to on 8 November 2001 with commencement to be proclaimed by the Minister, establishes the Eswatini Standards Authority as a body corporate with power to draft, issue, amend and withdraw Eswatini standards.

systems.owner: Government of Eswatini (Ministry responsible for Standards and Quality assurance)

note: The Act names no IT or data standard and no certification against one; its certification marks and licences cover commodities generally.
